target_publication.citation: Moreyra et al. 2025. A thorny tale: The origin and diversification of Cirsium (Compositae). Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution 204:108285.

primary_goal: Map each admissible Japan38 capitulum-transition edge to a defensible parent-child calendar-age interval and an ancestral-area uncertainty set without deriving dates from relative lineage-depth or figure digitization.

minimum_required.asset: best concatenated maximum-likelihood tree used as RelTime input
minimum_required.required_metadata: exact sample/tip labels and branch-length units
lower and upper 95% confidence limits keyed to machine-readable nodes
CP1, CP2 and CP3 descendant-tip definitions, distribution/bound semantics and source
paper sample label, taxon, BioSample/SRA accession, voucher and geographic area

strongly_preferred: per-locus post-orthology alignments used in the final concatenation
IQ-TREE best tree and model/partition outputs
ASTRAL species tree and gene-tree bundle
BioGeoBEARS input geography table and fitted-object or node-state probability export
Biogeographic stochastic-map summaries keyed to the dated tree
software/version/settings file, checksums and reuse licence
preferred_author_source_bundle.why_required: A figure image and article-level node summaries cannot identify all internal parent-child age windows or exact calibration-node placement for Japan38 transition histories.

published_dating_contract.input_tree: best maximum-likelihood tree from the 350-locus concatenated analysis

calibrations.constraint: root mean 17.7 Ma with normal distribution and soft lower bound 14 Ma
calibrations.node_identity_status: requires descendant-tip set or MEGA session

calibrations.constraint: minimum age 14 Ma based on a fossil cirsioid achene
calibrations.node_identity_status: requires descendant-tip set or MEGA session

calibrations.constraint: maximum age 5.6 Ma for the MRCA of sampled Cirsium latifolium populations based on Madeira geological age
calibrations.node_identity_status: requires exact duplicate-tip set or MEGA session

published_temporal_landmarks.landmark: separate Cirsium dipsacolepis arrival in Japan
Cirsium lineare ancestor expansion from East Asia to Japan

published_dating_contract.validation_rule: An author-source bundle is preferred. An independent reconstruction must reproduce the topology/crosswalk sufficiently for the admitted Japanese concepts and place the published temporal landmarks within declared tolerance or uncertainty before it can support event-window analysis.

available_inputs.EAzami_global_public_panel: 294 biological samples, 295 run accessions, 270 source-preserving taxon labels, including 256 Moreyra samples and 38 Chang samples
available_inputs.Japan38_trait_scaffold: exact concept/trait crosswalk plus undated ML and 1000 UFBoot trees

required_steps: Freeze exact sample admission and duplicate-tip rules against Supplementary Table S1.
Recover Compositae1061 targets from raw reads with source-compatible HybPiper settings.
Reproduce or explicitly replace the paper's manual orthology/paralogy adjudication without hiding disagreements.
Build the final locus set under the paper's missing-data/species-presence rules and audit whether 350 loci are recovered.
Infer the partitioned concatenated maximum-likelihood tree and retain topology/model uncertainty.
Apply the published CP1-CP3 constraints with RelTime/MEGA-compatible settings using exact node definitions.
Validate the reconstructed temporal landmarks and Japanese topology against the publication and independent East-Asian evidence.
Map admitted Japan38 concept descendant sets to dated branches; do not force nonmonophyletic duplicated concepts into one tip.
Freeze ancestral-area/paleolocation scenarios before extracting palaeoclimate.
Only then run the predeclared PALEO-PGEM event-window analysis.
independent_rebuild_fallback.non_equivalence_warning: The current 236-locus Japan38 phylogram is not the paper's 350-locus global RelTime input. Multiplying its branch lengths or relative lineage-depth by 2.4 Ma is prohibited.
independent_rebuild_fallback.result_role: Independent reconstruction/sensitivity if author outputs remain unavailable; not advertised as an exact reproduction unless topology, locus set, calibrations and temporal landmarks meet the frozen validation contract.

minimum_required: ancestral-area probabilities keyed to dated nodes or a declared alternative-area scenario set
geographic polygon definitions for the publication's 13 areas
rule for propagating uncertainty across possible areas and 1-degree PALEO-PGEM cells
land/sea-mask sensitivity for the Japanese archipelago
paleolocation_bundle.prohibition: Do not assign an ancestral branch to one modern descendant coordinate or extract palaeoclimate from a single modern range centroid.

promotion_gate.T2_current: orientation x hydric regime: recurrent history plus present Azami BIO12 and EAzami BIO15 domain correspondence
T3_requires: PALEO-PGEM BIO12/BIO15 level, change and variability with model uncertainty
topology, minimum-history and age uncertainty propagation

stop_rules: No calendar dates from relative lineage-depth.
No internal event dates from the published Japanese crown age alone.
No tree extraction by visually digitizing Figure 3 or Figure S3 as the primary analysis.
No substitution of current descendant niche centroids for ancestral climate.
No outcome-selected calibration or palaeoclimate variable.
No T3 promotion until the dated-tree and paleolocation gates both pass.
